text:
ci-nightdash: Nightdash alert: p50 generation latency +18% vs baseline for model redwood-alpha-v3 across prod regions. Spike started ~1768480000. Affected routes: /chat, /completion. Link: https://dash.redwood.internal/nightdash/alerts/9876 :rotating_light:
Maria: saw this alert, thanks. Any quick suspects? :eyes:
Aj: I noticed two merges in the window: PR#4550 (batching heuristic tweak) and PR#4532 (kernel prefetch priority). Both landed ~1768479000.
Suresh: KV cache hit-rate dropped ~12% on those routes at the same time, per metrics. p90 kv_lookup latency also up.
Noah: CI perf job `serve-latency-nightly` failed threshold this morning, job 548. Artifacts: https://ci.redwood/548/artifacts/latency.json
Elaine: ran a short flamegraph on canary (attached as paste):
```
flamegraph: high time in kernel_selector::choose_prefetch_path and kv::evict_candidates
callstack samples 60% kernel_selector
```
Maria: can we bisect? If it's a merge-order fluke we should revert the rollout. This is RC-blocking.
Aj: starting local bisect now. Quick note: PR4550 changed max_batch_window from 15ms -> 25ms and added a jitter. PR4532 adds `prefetch_priority` to kernels and a new code-path for streaming k-v fills.
Suresh: hypothesis: prefetch PR primes different cache sets, increases churn, interacts poorly with larger batch windows -> more KV thrash.
ci-nightdash: CI job 548: p50 +22%, p90 +30% vs baseline. Perf-run metadata: commit a3f9b77 (merge: 4550).
Noah: repro in staging? I can run a synthetic replay against staging with traffic mix.
Elaine: repro steps I'm using:
```
1) seed kv with 100k prefixes
2) replay traces from prod (trace-id 2026-03-12)
3) run 30m at 600rps, measure p50/p90 and kv_hit
```
Maria: thanks. Aj, any bisect progress?
Aj: bisect landed on commit a3f9b77 (merge PR4550). Reverting that single commit locally drops p50 back to baseline in my perf harness. Reapplying PR4532 alone doesn't reproduce the full spike.
Suresh: ok that points at batching heuristic change as primary trigger, but prefetch change likely amplifies it in prod. We should revert 4550 and hold 4532 until we understand interaction.
Noah: I'll queue a staging run with revert applied and also run a variant with only 4550 to confirm.
deploy-bot: Rollout 2026-03-15-rc started for release candidate. Action required: block further canary promotions until triage completes.
Maria: blocking promotion now. Opening rollout block in release channel.
Aj: opening PR to revert 4550: https://git.redwood/reverts/4550-revert. WIP, will request fast review and deploy to canary.
Elaine: small profiling note: when batch window increases, the runtime groups more heterogeneous sequences leading to longer kernel path selection time (kernel_selector hot path). That adds latency before token generation starts.
Suresh: plan:
- Aj: revert PR4550 and push canary rollback (ASAP)
- Noah: run 2h staging replay with revert vs current to validate KV hit and latency
- Suresh: add a regression test for kv retention under varied batch window and a telemetry counter for prefetch evictions
- Elaine: dig into kernel_selector logs to find heuristics thresholds that flip in mixed-batch scenarios
- Maria: hold RC rollout until green
Maria: tagging @oncall-eng for awareness.
Aj: revert PR opened, CI running. pinging infra for expedited canary deploy once CI passes. :pray:
Noah: I'll post staging results here once 2h run finishes (~2.5h total).
Elaine: adding a short traceable log line in kernel_selector to measure decision latency, will send a follow-up PR to master (non-blocking).
Maria: thanks team. This looks actionable and we can get RC unstuck once revert proves clean. :thumbsup:
